function.arguments: {"command":"cd 'C:\\AI\\benchmark\\v2\\results\\sandboxes\\knight__off\\term-log-rapor' && $data = @(); $files = @(Get-ChildItem -Path \"loglar\" -Recurse -Filter \"*.log\" | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }); foreach ($file in $files) { $relPath = $file.Substring(16); $errorCount = 0; $warnCount = 0; $infoCount = 0; Get-Content $file | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '^\\s*\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}\\s+\\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}\\s+(ERROR|WARN|INFO)\\s') { if ($_.Split(' ', 3)[2] -eq 'ERROR') { $errorCount++ } elseif ($_.Split(' ', 3)[2] -eq 'WARN') { $warnCount++ } elseif ($_.Split(' ', 3)[2] -eq 'INFO') { $infoCount++ } } }; $data += [PSCustomObject]@{ Dosya=$relPath; Error=$errorCount; Warn=$warnCount; Info=$infoCount } }; $sorted = $data | Sort-Object { $_.Error } -Descending | Sort-Object { $_.Dosya } -Ascending; $csvContent = \"dosya,error,warn,info`n\"; foreach ($row in $sorted) { $csvContent += \"$($row.Dosya),$($row.Error),$($row.Warn),$($row.Info)`n\" }; Set-Content -Path \"rapor.csv\" -Value $csvContent -NoNewline; Write-Host \"CSV oluşturuldu:\"; Get-Content rapor.csv","timeout":30}
